summary: The sideloaded Neighborhood Book Club package clearly loaded real data -- 'The Song of Achilles', 'The Odyssey (audiobook)', 'Trivial Pursuit: Book Lovers', a Sep 2026 meeting on 2026-09-14, and a genuine curated summary about Patroclus, fate vs free will, and Miller's narrative choices -- and identity is excellent ('Signed in as Walkthrough_Tester / Member' with a full role description). However, several of the Garden Club fixes did not fully generalize to this community's own theme/content: marketplace item names are truncated again for longer titles, holder attribution renders a raw slug ('Holder: book-member') on the one card that shows it, the Calendar weekday header row is present but rendered as a near-invisible clipped dark-on-dark ghost strip in this community's brown/near-black theme, and the FAB/bottom nav occlude content on four of five screens (including the community-list screen, not previously tested). Only the disabled-Save-hint fix cleanly generalized. Additional new defects: a bare schema field name 'label' leaking into an instance card, and a marketplace listing simultaneously chipped 'Available' and 'Overdue'.

holisticQuestionAnswers.question: Do the shared-code fixes proven on Garden Club generalize correctly to this different community's own content and field names?
holisticQuestionAnswers.answer: Only partially. PASS: no raw Dart-list-syntax dumps anywhere; disabled Save is explained ('No changes to save yet.'). PARTIAL: item/owner truncation fix works for moderate-length values ('The Odyssey (audiobook)', 'Holder: book-member' both fully visible) but longer titles ('The Song of Achilles (paperback)', 'Trivial Pursuit: Book Lovers ...') still exceed the fixed maxLines:2 budget and truncate -- this is a real remaining limit of the fix's chosen line-count, not evidence the fix regressed. FAIL: the weekday header exists in layout but renders illegibly on this community's dark theme (fixed/wrong-token coloring). FAIL: FAB/bottom-nav occlusion recurs on 4 of 5 screens, including the community-LIST screen (not covered by Garden Club's own re-verification evidence).
visibleEvidence: bc1-marketplace: 'The Song of Achilles (pap...' and 'Trivial Pursuit: Book Lovers ...' truncated; 'The Odyssey (audiobook)' and 'Holder: book-member' both fully visible on the same screen.
bc1-calendar: weekday header renders as a dark, half-height ghost strip against the near-black grid.
bc1-updated-card: the 'Add Community' FAB covers the 'Masjid Nur...' card title -- an occlusion instance on a screen never captured for Garden Club's own re-verification.
